title: Rory the Lion Who Was Afraid of the Dark

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who is hiding behind the tree?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you roar like Rory? Your turn!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. Lions live in Africa, on the big, grassy savanna.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. A family of lions is called a pride.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. A lion's roar is so loud, you can hear it five miles away!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But Rory has a little secret.

vo.speaker: rory
vo.text: When the sun goes down... I get scared of the dark.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Don't worry, Rory. Let's look at the night together.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The moon is like a night light, in the sky.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fireflies! They glow in the dark.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And the stars twinkle, twinkle, to say good night.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Rory takes a big, deep breath.

vo.speaker: rory
vo.text: I feel brave now! The dark is quiet... and pretty!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Being brave means trying, even when you feel a little bit scared.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, let's play and remember, with Rory!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Do you remember the lion facts?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What is a family of lions called?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How far away can you hear a lion's roar?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Show me five fingers! One, two, three, four, five!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's look at the night sky again!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What is big and round, up in the sky?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What are the tiny lights that glow in the dark?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what twinkles in the night sky?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When you feel scared, take a big breath, like Rory.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's say Rory's brave words together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What helps you feel brave at night?
